name: Trades & field services
human: Diagnosis, safety, pricing and crew assignments remain with your team.

examples.title: Catch the call
examples.problem: The phone rings while the crew is on site.
examples.fix: Collect the address, job type and callback window into one office handoff.

examples.title: Follow up on estimates
examples.problem: Yesterday’s quote is buried beneath today’s urgent jobs.
examples.fix: Queue follow-up and stop automatically when the customer replies.

examples.title: Prepare the next visit
examples.problem: Job details live across texts and a notebook.
examples.fix: Gather access notes, photos and approved scope into a crew brief.

name: Property management
audience: Residential, multifamily and commercial property teams
human: Emergencies, tenant matters, work authorization and spend stay human.

examples.title: Complete maintenance intake
examples.problem: A leak report arrives without the unit number.
examples.fix: Collect the property, unit, photos and urgency before routing the request.

examples.title: Coordinate vendors
examples.problem: The appointment was confirmed in somebody else’s text thread.
examples.fix: Track the agreed visit, access details and next action in one shared view.

examples.title: Prepare owner updates
examples.problem: Friday reporting starts by copying facts from five tabs.
examples.fix: Draft a source-linked status recap for the property manager to review.

name: Professional services
audience: Legal, accounting, consulting and technical practices
human: Professional advice, privilege, client acceptance and final document review stay with qualified staff.

examples.title: Collect missing documents
examples.problem: An engagement waits on two files nobody has chased.
examples.fix: Track a document checklist and prepare reminders through approved secure tools.

examples.title: Route new enquiries
examples.problem: The same intake details get entered into several systems.
examples.fix: Organize the initial request and route it to the responsible person.

examples.title: Keep deadlines visible
examples.problem: A milestone lives in one partner’s inbox.
examples.fix: Surface approved dates, owners and outstanding tasks in a shared work queue.

name: Logistics & transport
audience: Freight brokers, local carriers, dispatch and warehousing
human: Dispatch, safety, carrier decisions and commercial approvals remain human.

examples.title: Get billing ready
examples.problem: The delivery is done but proof-of-delivery is missing.
examples.fix: Track required documents and flag the loads that need a follow-up.

examples.title: Prepare a dispatch brief
examples.problem: A route change never reaches the next shift.
examples.fix: Compile the agreed address, timing and exception notes for dispatch review.

examples.title: Draft shipment updates
examples.problem: Customers call because status is scattered.
examples.fix: Turn approved status events into customer-update drafts.

name: Marine services
audience: Marinas, boat service, repair and marine retailers
human: Vessel safety, diagnosis, scope and final completion promises remain with the team.

examples.title: Capture vessel details
examples.problem: The service request names the boat but not its berth.
examples.fix: Gather location, vessel details and photos for the coordinator.

examples.title: Track estimate approvals
examples.problem: Work waits on a reply buried in a message thread.
examples.fix: Make the estimate status and next follow-up visible.

examples.title: Keep recurring work visible
examples.problem: The next service date sits on a notepad.
examples.fix: Queue reminders from the maintenance schedule your team approves.

name: Cleaning & facilities
audience: Commercial janitorial, residential cleaning and facility teams
human: Staffing, site access, safety and client relationship decisions stay human.

examples.title: Prepare site instructions
examples.problem: A replacement cleaner cannot find the access notes.
examples.fix: Assemble the approved site checklist and handoff instructions.

examples.title: Close inspection issues
examples.problem: A quality issue is photographed but never assigned.
examples.fix: Route the inspection note to a named owner with a follow-up date.

examples.title: Keep renewals moving
examples.problem: A recurring contract is close to renewal with no reminder.
examples.fix: Surface upcoming reviews and prepare a client-check-in draft.

name: Retail & consumer services
audience: Independent stores, repair counters and consumer-service shops
human: Refunds, purchasing and customer exceptions need staff approval.

examples.title: Answer routine questions
examples.problem: Stock and opening-hours questions interrupt the counter.
examples.fix: Prepare replies using approved information and escalate uncertainty.

examples.title: Route repair intake
examples.problem: A dropped-off item lacks the fault description.
examples.fix: Capture the item, issue and contact preferences in a consistent intake.

examples.title: Follow up after a visit
examples.problem: An opted-in customer never hears the useful next step.
examples.fix: Prepare consent-based reminders and service follow-ups in existing tools.

name: Food & hospitality
audience: Restaurants, caterers, venues and hospitality operators
human: Food safety, allergies, staffing and booking commitments stay with staff.

examples.title: Organize catering enquiries
examples.problem: The date, headcount and budget arrive in separate messages.
examples.fix: Collect the essentials and prepare one brief for the event coordinator.

examples.title: Track reservation changes
examples.problem: A changed headcount never reaches the floor lead.
examples.fix: Route confirmed changes into the team’s approved planning view.

examples.title: Collect supplier details
examples.problem: The next order depends on an unconfirmed delivery.
examples.fix: Flag missing confirmations and prepare a supplier follow-up.

name: Beauty & wellness
audience: Salons, spas, studios and nonclinical wellness services
human: Service suitability, sensitive conversations and health advice remain human.

examples.title: Prepare appointment reminders
examples.problem: An upcoming visit still needs confirmation.
examples.fix: Use approved scheduling tools to queue consent-based reminders.

examples.title: Organize new-client intake
examples.problem: Preferences and service history sit in different places.
examples.fix: Gather permitted details before the appointment without collecting unnecessary data.

examples.title: Follow up on packages
examples.problem: A repeat visit is due with no clear next step.
examples.fix: Prepare an opted-in rebooking reminder for staff review.

name: Lodging & travel
audience: Independent lodging, tour operators and vacation-rental teams
human: Guest disputes, refunds, safety and booking commitments remain human.

examples.title: Prepare arrival details
examples.problem: Guests ask the same check-in questions.
examples.fix: Draft consistent arrival instructions from approved property information.

examples.title: Coordinate turnovers
examples.problem: The checkout update never reaches housekeeping.
examples.fix: Route confirmed status changes into the turnover checklist.

examples.title: Route guest requests
examples.problem: A maintenance request arrives across multiple channels.
examples.fix: Create one issue summary with the responsible team and next step.

name: Automotive
audience: Repair shops, detailers, tire and vehicle-service businesses
human: Diagnosis, safety, estimates and work authorization stay with qualified staff.

examples.title: Capture service enquiries
examples.problem: The vehicle and requested work are missing from the voicemail.
examples.fix: Collect basic service details before the advisor calls back.

examples.title: Track estimate decisions
examples.problem: A vehicle waits while an approval sits in an inbox.
examples.fix: Make pending approvals visible and prepare the next follow-up.

examples.title: Draft progress updates
examples.problem: Advisors keep answering the same status calls.
examples.fix: Prepare updates from approved job milestones for the advisor to review.

name: Recreation & events
audience: Gyms, clubs, activity operators and event businesses
human: Safety, capacity, waivers and event commitments remain the operator’s responsibility.

examples.title: Organize event enquiries
examples.problem: Date, group size and requirements arrive piecemeal.
examples.fix: Collect a consistent event brief for the coordinator.

examples.title: Keep booking details aligned
examples.problem: A changed time never reaches the instructor.
examples.fix: Route confirmed changes to the relevant staff and checklist.

examples.title: Prepare member follow-ups
examples.problem: An opted-in enquiry goes quiet after the first visit.
examples.fix: Queue an approved check-in without inventing availability or offers.

name: Healthcare practices
audience: Administrative workflows for clinics and healthcare offices
human: No clinical advice or decisions. Privacy, HIPAA suitability, access and vendor agreements must be checked before any patient data is used.

examples.title: Track administrative tasks
examples.problem: A nonclinical task is waiting with no named owner.
examples.fix: Build an approved queue for routine office administration.

examples.title: Prepare appointment communications
examples.problem: Routine scheduling messages take staff away from the desk.
examples.fix: Draft approved administrative communications within suitable secure systems.

examples.title: Track vendor paperwork
examples.problem: A supplier document is missing from a compliance checklist.
examples.fix: Monitor document status and prepare reminders without handling clinical decisions.

name: Finance & insurance
audience: Insurance agencies, financial offices and bookkeeping operations
human: No financial advice, underwriting, credit or coverage decisions. Confidential data, compliance and vendor permissions require review.

examples.title: Collect administrative documents
examples.problem: The application checklist is incomplete.
examples.fix: Track approved required items and route missing-document reminders.

examples.title: Keep renewals visible
examples.problem: An upcoming review date is buried in a spreadsheet.
examples.fix: Surface dates and prepare a licensed professional’s review queue.

examples.title: Prepare meeting context
examples.problem: A staff member manually gathers the same records each time.
examples.fix: Compile permitted source links and a brief for human verification.

name: Education & childcare
audience: Tutoring, training, childcare and learning businesses
human: Safeguarding, child data, enrollment decisions and educational judgment stay with authorized staff.

examples.title: Organize adult enquiries
examples.problem: A parent or learner asks about a program in several channels.
examples.fix: Capture minimal permitted details and route the enquiry to staff.

examples.title: Prepare routine reminders
examples.problem: A schedule change creates a long chain of manual messages.
examples.fix: Draft approved reminders through the organization’s authorized channels.

examples.title: Track staff paperwork
examples.problem: A required staff document is due but not assigned.
examples.fix: Create an internal checklist and reminder queue, separate from child records.

name: Real estate brokerage
human: Agency relationships, legal disclosures, negotiations and transaction advice stay with licensed professionals.

examples.title: Route property enquiries
examples.problem: An enquiry waits while the agent is showing a property.
examples.fix: Capture the basics and assign the appropriate follow-up owner.

examples.title: Prepare showing coordination
examples.problem: Availability and access notes are split across messages.
examples.fix: Compile confirmed scheduling details for the agent to approve.

examples.title: Track transaction checklists
examples.problem: A deadline is visible only in one email thread.
examples.fix: Surface approved due dates, document status and the responsible person.

name: Manufacturing & industrial
audience: Small manufacturers, fabricators and industrial suppliers
human: Engineering, quality, safety, production and purchasing decisions stay with qualified staff.

examples.title: Organize quote requests
examples.problem: An RFQ is missing drawings or quantities.
examples.fix: Collect required documents and route one brief to estimating.

examples.title: Prepare order-status updates
examples.problem: Staff manually reconcile progress before every reply.
examples.fix: Gather approved milestones into a draft for account-team review.

examples.title: Track supplier confirmations
examples.problem: A missing confirmation delays the next planning step.
examples.fix: Surface outstanding vendor responses and prepare a follow-up.

name: Technology & IT
audience: IT providers, software businesses and technical service teams
human: Security changes, privileged access, deployments and technical commitments require authorized review.

examples.title: Route service intake
examples.problem: A ticket reaches the wrong queue without enough context.
examples.fix: Collect the permitted basics and route to the appropriate team.

examples.title: Prepare account handoffs
examples.problem: Implementation context is scattered across several tools.
examples.fix: Assemble approved notes, dependencies and outstanding decisions.

examples.title: Draft routine reporting
examples.problem: The weekly status recap starts from a blank document.
examples.fix: Gather source-linked facts into a reviewable report draft.

name: Something else?
audience: Other owner-led businesses and unusual workflows
human: Fit, access, risk and expertise must be checked. A category label is not a promise of compatibility.

examples.title: Map the handoff
examples.problem: Work keeps stopping between two people or tools.
examples.fix: Walk through a real example and identify the smallest useful fix.

examples.title: Reduce repeated entry
examples.problem: The same approved details are copied several times.
examples.fix: Check native options before proposing a new connection.

examples.title: Make the next step clear
examples.problem: An outstanding task depends on somebody remembering.
examples.fix: Agree a named owner, trigger and visible follow-up point.
